presets.label: Hard: spread to forecast error
presets.concept: Rank aligned price grains, select a forecast vintage, then compare with actual demand
presets.question: For CAISO on October 21, 2026 local time, find the hour with the highest signed real-time minus day-ahead hub LMP spread. Average the 12 five-minute real-time hub LMPs within each hour before subtracting that hour's day-ahead hub LMP; negative spreads are allowed. Break ties by the earliest UTC hour. For the winning hour, using the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 12:00 UTC, what is forecast MW minus actual hourly demand MW? Report the signed error in MW.

demos.label: Peak demand
demos.question: What was ERCOT's highest hourly demand in MW on October 19, 2026 (local time)?
demos.sql: SELECT max(demand_mw) AS peak_mw FROM core.fact_balance_hourly JOIN core.dim_iso USING (iso_id) WHERE iso_code = 'ERCOT' AND interval_start_local::DATE = DATE '2026-10-19'

demos.label: Forecast cutoff
demos.question: What was ERCOT's latest hourly load forecast available at or before October 20, 2026 18:00 UTC for delivery on October 21 at 5 pm local? Report forecast MW.
demos.sql: SELECT forecast_mw FROM core.ercot_load_forecast_hourly WHERE interval_start_local = TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 17:00' AND publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 18:00' ORDER BY publish_time_utc DESC LIMIT 1

demos.label: Battery energy
demos.question: How much gross battery discharge energy in MWh was observed in CAISO on October 21, 2026, using five-minute storage dispatch?
demos.sql: SELECT sum(discharge_mw) / 12 AS discharge_mwh FROM core.caiso_storage_dispatch_5min WHERE interval_start_local::DATE = DATE '2026-10-21'

catalog.name: core.dim_iso
core.dim_fuel
catalog.ddl:
-- Fuels and technologies shared by generation facts and queue projects.
CREATE TABLE core.dim_fuel (
    fuel_id        SMALLINT PRIMARY KEY,
    fuel_code      VARCHAR NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- natural_gas, coal, oil, nuclear, hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, biomass, battery, hydrogen, transmission, other
    name           VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    category       VARCHAR NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('fossil', 'nuclear', 'renewable', 'storage', 'other')),
    is_renewable   BOOLEAN NOT NULL,         -- hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, biomass
    is_carbon_free BOOLEAN NOT NULL          -- renewable or nuclear
);

catalog.name: core.dim_location
catalog.ddl:
-- Fictional price locations: three electrical buses and one trading hub per ISO.
-- Bus and hub IDs are not interchangeable.
CREATE TABLE core.dim_location (
    location_id   INTEGER  PRIMARY KEY,
    iso_id        SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id),
    location_code VARCHAR  NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- ISO_BUS_A, ISO_BUS_B, ISO_BUS_C or ISO_HUB, with ISO replaced by the ISO code
    location_type VARCHAR  NOT NULL CHECK (location_type IN ('bus', 'hub'))  -- no implied bus-to-hub averaging weights
);

catalog.name: core.dim_queue_status
core.fact_balance_hourly
catalog.ddl:
-- Hourly balance: total demand (load) and net generation across all fuels, the denominator of fuel shares.
-- One row per ISO and hour. Local timestamps repeat in the fall-back hour, so the key is UTC.
-- Joining to generation by ISO/hour is one-to-many: each balance measure repeats for every fuel.
-- Aggregate balance and fuel generation separately before combining totals, or make the join one-to-one.
CREATE TABLE core.fact_balance_hourly (
    iso_id               SMALLINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id),
    interval_start_utc   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    interval_start_local TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    demand_mw            DOUBLE,  -- demand (load), MW
    demand_forecast_mw   DOUBLE,  -- one simple day-ahead demand estimate per hour, MW; no publication time, so not usable for a forecast known at a cutoff
    net_generation_mw    DOUBLE,  -- net generation from all fuels, MW (the denominator of fuel shares)
    PRIMARY KEY (iso_id, interval_start_utc)
);

catalog.name: core.fact_generation_hourly
catalog.ddl:
-- Hourly generation by fuel: one row per ISO, hour and fuel; MW averaged over the hour.
-- Battery is net output: negative while charging.
CREATE TABLE core.fact_generation_hourly (
    iso_id               SMALLINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id),
    interval_start_utc   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    interval_start_local TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    fuel_id              SMALLINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_fuel (fuel_id),
    generation_mw        DOUBLE    NOT NULL,  -- generation (output) from this fuel, MW averaged over the hour
    PRIMARY KEY (iso_id, interval_start_utc, fuel_id)
);

catalog.name: core.fact_load_5min
catalog.ddl:
-- Five-minute load: one row per CAISO or ERCOT interval, local dates 2026-10-15 through 2026-10-21.
-- Can differ slightly from hourly demand.
CREATE TABLE core.fact_load_5min (
    iso_id               SMALLINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id),
    interval_start_utc   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    interval_start_local TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    load_mw              DOUBLE,  -- load (demand), MW
    PRIMARY KEY (iso_id, interval_start_utc)
);

catalog.name: core.fact_generation_5min
catalog.ddl:
-- Five-minute generation by fuel for CAISO and ERCOT, local dates 2026-10-15 through 2026-10-21.
-- Battery is net output: negative while charging.
CREATE TABLE core.fact_generation_5min (
    iso_id               SMALLINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id),

    interval_start_local TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    fuel_id              SMALLINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_fuel (fuel_id),
    generation_mw        DOUBLE    NOT NULL,  -- generation (output) from this fuel, MW over the five minutes
    PRIMARY KEY (iso_id, interval_start_utc, fuel_id)
);

catalog.name: core.queue_project
catalog.ddl:
-- Interconnection queue: one fictional current project per row, as of 2026-10-21.
-- No historical status snapshots: entry dates cannot reconstruct what the queue looked like earlier.
CREATE TABLE core.queue_project (
    project_id     INTEGER  PRIMARY KEY,
    iso_id         SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id),
    queue_id       VARCHAR,                -- fictional ISO-prefixed queue identifier
    project_name   VARCHAR,                -- fictional project name
    developer      VARCHAR,                -- interconnecting entity
    county         VARCHAR,                -- project county
    state          VARCHAR,                -- two-letter US state
    fuel_id        SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_fuel (fuel_id),
    technology     VARCHAR,                -- fictional technology label
    status_code    VARCHAR  NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_queue_status (status_code),
    status_raw     VARCHAR,                -- fictional raw status label behind status_code
    capacity_mw    DOUBLE,                 -- proposed capacity, MW (not built capacity or output)
    is_hybrid      BOOLEAN  NOT NULL,      -- a non-storage project paired with storage
    queue_date     DATE,                   -- date the project entered the queue
    proposed_cod   DATE,                   -- proposed commercial operation date
    withdrawn_date DATE,                   -- date a withdrawn project left the queue
    completed_date DATE                    -- date a completed project entered service
);

catalog.name: core.caiso_lmp_rt_bus_5min
catalog.ddl:
-- CAISO only, local dates 2026-10-15 through 2026-10-21. Real-time five-minute LMPs at individual electrical buses; NOT hub prices or day-ahead prices.
CREATE TABLE core.caiso_lmp_rt_bus_5min (
    iso_id SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_iso (iso_id) CHECK (iso_id = 1),
    interval_start_utc TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,  -- delivery interval start, UTC; join time series on this and iso_id
    interval_start_local TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,  -- delivery interval start on the ISO clock; calendar filters use this
    location_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES core.dim_location (location_id),  -- price location in core.dim_location; bus and hub grains differ
    lmp DOUBLE NOT NULL,  -- total locational marginal price, USD/MWh; equals energy + congestion + loss
    energy DOUBLE NOT NULL,  -- energy price component, USD/MWh
    congestion DOUBLE NOT NULL,  -- congestion price component, USD/MWh
    loss DOUBLE NOT NULL,  -- marginal-loss price component, USD/MWh
    PRIMARY KEY (iso_id, interval_start_utc, location_id)
);
